given: one or more stock records exist across locations
when: the operator opens the home stock-by-location screen
then: a table renders one row per stock record, each row showing that record's SKU, its location, and its quantity
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the full read path from the paired-branch stock_records rows, through app/repositories (the only ORM-touching layer) and app/services (read business logic), out the app/routes JSON boundary (renders_via react), and into the client/ React table component. The row-per-record shape is a presentation contract owned by the SPA page/component; the boundary returns JSON only. Cross-cutting: read-only, no auth/transaction concern beyond the branch connection sourced from DATABASE_URL (NFR7). Verified through the real-branch integration suite plus the client component test (NFR4/NFR5).
